question: Do smaller learning rates produce useful, less disruptive updates from the trained W3 endpoints with their actual Adam moments?
partition: Existing consumed development data only. First1024/source fit, remaining1024 evaluate; sources tested separately.
startingStates: Independently reload each latest32 optimizer for every arm; retain moments/step and change only learning rate in memory.
measurements: Cross entropy, outcome MSE, residual scale and RMS change from frozen Gen32 on fit/evaluation halves; training nanoseconds.
interpretation: Optimizer diagnostic, not substantive competitive training or evidence of chess strength. Tiny reused subsets cannot establish an optimal long-run rate. CP data-quality sensitivity is separately recorded.
resources: After primary tournament jobs finish: one BelowNormal JVM, ActiveProcessorCount1, Xmx768m, <=300seconds total. Never save trained models or mutate source stores.
